title: ID0469016-DC/Si-D/AT-[RVP/T4170004765] Programming error occured in FB3002
description:

the issue was caused by an intermittent contact at the resistor on CQ2

The charger is offline since 2 days ago. As such, we cannot do any kind of troubleshooting or analysis.
Please bring back the charger online so we can proceed.
I checked and there was a reboot performed yesterday at night and the charger didn't come back online.
If we can ask the customer for a picture of the HMI maybe we can get a hint.
Thanks a lot!
Best regards,
Francisco
